text: Henkel AG & Co. KGaA's shares are traded on German stock exchanges. Members of the Henkel family share-pooling agreement held 61.85 percent of the ordinary shares as of 19 March 2026; the latest voting-right notifications Henkel lists are BlackRock at 3.03% and Silchester at 3.01%.
short: The Henkel family share-pooling agreement holds 61.85% of Henkel's ordinary (voting) shares.

source.name: Henkel: Shares (shareholder structure)
source.quote: 61.85 percent of our ordinary shares (as of March 19, 2026) are held by members of the Henkel family share-pooling agreement.
source.note: Corporate page, no date shown; opened 2026-09-30.
